header.notes: SnowPro-style 'SNOW COVER PROFILE' (older layout). Parks Canada / Banff-Yoho-Kootenay. Obs: SM CA RO. Profile Type: Test. Date printed '08/01/2006', Time 14:00. H.A.S.L. 2087 Metres; Co-ord blank. HS 107, HSW 0, rho 0. Surface Roughness: Smooth. Foot penetration printed 110 (> HS; notes say 'Foot pen to ground.'). Free text below chart: 'ADFAR PROJECT WINTER 2005-2006. UTM: NH 544844, 5719284 Map: Hector Lake 82N/9, NAD27. Site Description: (blank). Danger Rating Pre Assesment: TL Considerable, BTL Moderate. Danger Rating Post Assesment: No Change. CTE x 3 (6,7,8) @ 65 on FC. SP. Foot pen to ground. While travelling up to treeline there was significant whumping, cracking and collapsing of snow pack at the 65 cm layer. Area adjacent to pit collapsed and slid at the 65 cm layer prior to pit being dug.' Top dashed table row (empty) lies above the surface.
